Name: EQUIP_PARAM_ANTIQUE_ST
Description: Relics. Each relic has a colour, rolls up to three effects from its effect tables and, for Deep relics, up to three curse effects from its curse tables.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on 187 of 1,397 rows.

Fields.Name: Relic Color
Fields.Description: Colour of the relic, which decides the vessel slots it fits: 0 Burning (red), 1 Drizzly (blue), 2 Luminous (yellow), 3 Tranquil (green), as AntiqueStandParam's slot colours.

Fields.Name: Sort Group
Fields.Description: Group value given to the relic menus (sorting/grouping). Retail: 255 standard and unique relics, 250 / 251 Depths relics, 10 the remembrance relics.

Fields.Name: Is Salable
Fields.Description: Non-zero: the relic can be sold. Retail: 0 on 186 rows, the starting Delicate Scene relics among them.

Fields.Name: Is Depths Relic
Fields.Description: Set: a Depths relic (retail: the Deep rows). Its curse tables are rolled when it is created and its curse effects are applied; clear: the curse tables are ignored.

Fields.Name: Use Color Icon
Fields.Description: Set: menus show the relic's colour as an icon. Retail: set on the 45 remembrance relics (Night of the Beast...).

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Sort order of the relic in menus.

Fields.Name: Collection Entry ID
Fields.Description: When the relic is obtained this ID is recorded in a list of up to 150 distinct entries; relics with the same value count as one entry. -1: not recorded. Where the list is shown is not established. Retail: 3000 on 536 rows, 20000-30035 elsewhere (alongside the icon).

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: 1
Fields.Description: AttachEffectTableParam table rolled for the relic's first effect when the relic is created. -1: no effect in this slot (the relic size is the number of tables set).

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: 2
Fields.Description: As Attached Effect Table: 1, for the second effect; an effect already rolled, or one with the same Compatibility ID, is excluded.

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: 3
Fields.Description: As Attached Effect Table: 1, for the third effect.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the relic in menus.

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: Curse 1
Fields.Description: AttachEffectTableParam table rolled for the first curse (demerit). Only rolled when Is Depths Relic is set. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: Curse 2
Fields.Description: As Curse 1, for the second curse; excludes the effects and curses already rolled.

Fields.Name: Attached Effect Table: Curse 3
Fields.Description: As Curse 1, for the third curse.
